# Sketch v4 addenda ready for independent signoff

Turn state: revision authoring complete; fresh independent signoff pending. No author approval or implementation authorization.

Actual author: Codex authority-sketch-v4-author, native thread 01a11985-64f1-7150-96d8-e92930acab65, separate Joe-assigned session on 2026-10-07 America/Phoenix. AIDA_SESSION_ID absent; no authenticated grant/lease asserted. This author must not approve these addenda.

Pinned baseline: 199e591b07aa76a59cd34f0a41946f918501f6ba. Read AGENTS.md, two-seat/rework/recovery disciplines, aida-orchestrate sketch gate, full owning canonical specs/comments, full v3 sketches, SKETCH_V3_READY.md and actual INDEPENDENT_SKETCH_V3_SIGNOFF.md. Canonical v2/v3 bodies were compared byte-for-byte with files. Baseline source was inspected for commit, PR rebase including forced pr-N fetch, cascade and other rebase producers, store/team writers and production hooks. Installed Git manual confirms prepared ref-lock semantics, zero-old caveat, symbolic-ref exclusion and missing aborted callback after prepared rejection.

## Canonical publication and readback

All canonical reads/writes use /home/joe/ai/aida/target/agent/aida. BUG-1808 was posted and verified first; BUG-1802 then posted and verified. Both begin `SKETCH (awaiting advisor signoff):` and name actual provenance.

- BUG-1808: [BUG-1808-sketch-v4-addendum.md](BUG-1808-sketch-v4-addendum.md); canonical comment `01a11990-553d-7f80-bcf6-21f9b3e06bfe`; 26107 bytes; SHA256 `7ed0561699c5f184572612e03f19b72aa3e06cf049eb4ea6958ef45da369e4f2`. Exactly one byte-equal body, including trailing newline; explicit author verified.
- BUG-1802: [BUG-1802-sketch-v4-addendum.md](BUG-1802-sketch-v4-addendum.md); canonical comment `01a11990-78a8-7780-9055-0b76eeec7049`; 31561 bytes; SHA256 `c2832ce1e4e4d1f4eabcbc73c75978e63487e492c6726b2944b552f2ca293206`. Exactly one byte-equal body, including trailing newline; explicit author verified.

Each is a normative addendum, not a replacement v3 body. Each pins its exact v3 comment/hash, lists superseded sentences/sections and preserves unaffected mechanisms and binding A–E/signoff decisions. BUG-1802 additionally pins the exact common BUG-1808 addendum hash. Prior artifacts are not rewritten.

## Independent decisions requested

1. BUG-1808: judge the concrete parent-serviced authenticated callback pump, immutable per-operation observations, pure exact-prepared-content gate invocation, service ref/effect classes, team/store publication adapters and dead-publisher recovery. Hooks never reacquire home under Git locks; FINAL/COMMIT remain parent-owned. Ordinary team/store/code positives and publication/recovery concurrent-writer witnesses are explicit.
2. BUG-1802: judge consumption of that same transport and the separate pre-mutation AcceptedDefaultObservation. Immutable B stays fixed. W(H) includes full DAG minus pinned accepted-default history PLUS monotonically retained old source obligations; unrelated closed squash M needs no fabricated work authorship, while unknown feature sources never wash out. Real PR forced-fetch, cascade, finish/rebase, conflict continuation and auto-stash adapters are named, with production-hook witnesses.

Binding one-way implementation order: BUG-1808 owns and independently delivers LaunchPublisher/publication/assignment/receipt/callback substrate FIRST. BUG-1802 consumes it later for work provenance/START/verdict enforcement. BUG-1808 reviewer identity binding does not require BUG-1802 policy. No duplicate launcher or reciprocal prerequisite. Each addendum can receive a separate design verdict. No canonical relationship/queue edit was made to encode this order.

Implementation obligations remain real work: callback/gate extraction, exact Git backend/effect journaling, private team/store preparation, accepted-default closure validation and continuation mappings. They are proposed executable mechanisms, not existing functionality. If review finds an unresolved join, name it concretely. No new boundary is offered as permission to waive an existing positive. Native-daemon/raw-unwrapped/opaque-import/unavailable-platform limits remain exactly the v3 binding refusals, not positive support claims. No operator policy fork or acceptance relaxation requested.

## Preservation and limits

Verified before/after canonical description, status/stored status, exposed history, queue membership and relationships unchanged; every prior comment unchanged with only one requested addendum appended per bug. Both remain Approved, which does not authorize implementation without independent sketch signoff. All prior hashed orchestrator artifacts stayed identical except coordinator-owned `latest.md`, which received concurrent orchestration updates; this author did not write or restore it. Named v1/v2/v3 sketches, readiness notices and independent signoffs remain byte-identical.

Tracked diff against the baseline was empty before canonical posting. Only requested new handoff files and canonical sketch comments were authored; no code/build/tests/status/queue/grant/hold changes, dispatch, commit/push or merge. No live store/user-file/timer/peer experiment. Hash/readback checks are document verification, not proposed acceptance tests. All named tests remain unexecuted proposed work. Sandbox permission did not waive any application gate; canonical comment writes succeeded normally without a bypass.

Fresh independent advisor signoff follows. Final authority-sensitive merge remains Joe/operator-owned.
